title: console2svg configuration
description: Configuration consumed by console2svg --config. Command-line arguments override these values.

include.description: Configuration files to load first, resolved relative to this file.

capture.description: Terminal dimensions, frame selection, cropping, and cast recording.

video.description: Animated SVG and video timing settings.

castPath.description: Path to an asciicast file to render instead of running a command.

path.description: Output file path; the extension selects SVG, image, or video conversion.

stdOut.description: Write SVG to standard output instead of a file.

saveFramesDir.description: Directory in which to save every static SVG frame.

size.description: Target image size: WIDTH, WIDTHxHEIGHT, WIDTHx*, or *xHEIGHT.

frame.description: Zero-based visual frame index for image output.

time.description: Frame time in seconds, or START-END seconds range.

cropTop.description: Top crop value in px, ch, or a text pattern.

cropRight.description: Right crop value in px or ch.

cropBottom.description: Bottom crop value in px, ch, or a text pattern.

cropLeft.description: Left crop value in px or ch.

saveCastPath.description: Path at which to write the captured asciicast.

sleep.description: Seconds to show the final frame after command completion.

timing.description: Whether to normalize or preserve measured frame timings.

coalesceMs.description: Merge output chunks received within this many milliseconds.

path.description: Input replay JSON file to execute.

savePath.description: Path at which to save captured interactive input.

timeout.description: Maximum command execution time in seconds.

noColorEnv.description: Do not set terminal color environment variables for child commands.

noDeleteEnvs.description: Keep CI and TF_BUILD environment variables for child commands.

window.description: Window chrome style: none, macos, windows, transparent, a *-pc variant, or a chrome JSON path.

pcPadding.description: Outer desktop padding in pixels when PC mode is active.

background.description: One background color or image path, or two colors for a gradient.

withCommand.description: Prepend the executed command as a prompt line.

header.description: Header text displayed above terminal content.
